personality_one_liner: A premium, functional, and nautical-themed scheduling utility blending crisp iOS usability with deep marine blues and gold accents.

spacing.rule: Maintain generous vertical breathing room. Forms should feel spacious, not cramped. Use md (12pt) and lg (16pt) for component padding, and xl (24pt) for section margins.

do's: Use on sticky headers over scrolling forms
Use on the floating/sticky primary CTA at the bottom of forms
Use as overlay on hero images
dont's: Do not use on regular input fields or list rows
Do not use on dense data lists

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: Secure entry via CPF validation for registered boat owners.

states.error: Modal or inline red text: 'CPF não cadastrado' + Retry button.

screens.layout: Full-bleed hero image of a marina at the top with a vertical gradient scrim fading to solid surface at the bottom. The bottom half contains a clean, large typography CPF input field and a sticky 'Entrar' (brandPrimary) button at the bottom.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Main hub offering the 4 core actions (Request/Alter Launch & Return).
screens.layout: Header showing user's Name and Boat Name. A 2x2 grid or stacked list of 4 large, touch-friendly cards. Cards use surfaceSecondary with subtle shadow tier 1. 'Solicitar' cards can have a brandPrimary icon, while 'Alterar' cards can have a brandSecondary (Gold) icon to differentiate.

screens.name: SolicitarDescida
screens.purpose: Form to schedule a boat launch (descida) with required details.
screens.layout: Scrollable form with clean labels above inputs. Use platform-native time pickers restricted to 08:30-17:00. Fields: Day/Time, Expected Return, Destination, Passengers, Responsible, Observation. A sticky brandPrimary CTA at the bottom inside a glass container.

screens.name: SolicitarSubida
screens.purpose: Form to schedule a boat return (subida).
screens.layout: Similar to Descida form, but only containing Day/Time (interval 08:30-17:30). Sticky primary CTA at the bottom.

screens.name: AlterarSolicitacoes
screens.purpose: List today's requests (Descida or Subida) to select and edit.

states.empty: Nautical illustration (steering wheel/compass) + 'Nenhuma solicitação para hoje'.
states.error: Error fetching today's requests + Retry button.

screens.layout: List view. Each row shows Time, Type, and Status. Tapping a row navigates to the respective form (Descida or Subida) pre-filled with data for editing.

login_hero.alt: Aerial view of yachts docked at a marina

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette: Deep Marine Blue (#0B2545) and Gold (#C5A059) as requested in the user brief. Do not use generic AI purples or indigos.
Implement the 'Solicitar Descida' form with the exact fields requested: Date/Time (08:30-17:00), Return Date/Time, Destination, Passengers, Responsible, and Observations.
Ensure time pickers strictly enforce the business rules: Descida (08:30-17:00) and Subida (08:30-17:30). Provide clear inline validation.
For the Login screen, use the `login_hero` image with a top-to-bottom vertical gradient scrim so the CPF input area at the bottom has a clean, readable background.
Use a sticky bottom CTA in a glass container for all forms so the user can easily submit without scrolling to the very bottom.
Avoid unnecessary bottom tabs. The app is a simple utility; a stack navigation originating from the Home hub is sufficient and more focused.
